The Business Education Partnership (UK) Ltd, operating across Essex and East London, is a registered charity known as BEP Group. Since 1992, we have been delivering enterprise education, work related learning and work experience. Our alternative education provision for young people, aged 14 – 16 started in 1999 and became a registered independent school, BEP Academy, in 2017.

The Business Education Partnership (UK) Ltd, known as BEP Group, is a registered charity specialising in supporting young people through Alternative Education and Work Experience. We have our own Independent School providing full-time alternative education to up-to 90 children in Year 9, 10 and 11. We are based in East London and Essex.

pageCache.pageTitle: Work experience service re-start | BEP Group
pageCache.text:
As employers welcome back their colleagues to the place of work, social distancing rules have changed and education gets back (in the main) to pre-Covid ways of working, we are pleased to announce the restarting of the Work Experience Service.
Over the next few weeks we will be contacting schools and booking work experience slots for January to July 2022 (a number of schools have already been in contact to request their slot – if your school hasn’t yet, please get in contact with the team).
The work experience service (organised by BEP Group) covers Essex, Southend-On-Sea, Thurrock and the East London boroughs of Havering, Redbridge and Waltham Forest. If your school is outside these areas, and there isn’t a local work experience organiser or Education Business Partnership (EBP), please get in touch to see if we can help.
Our Central London and West End pre-placement vetting service for all work experience organisers and schools/colleges nationally has also restarted. If you need a job description and young person’s risk assessment provided for a central London placement, please get in touch either by using the contact form of by calling 01708 436440.

From these pages, you can find literature on Work Experience, organised by the Business Education Partnership (BEP Group) for schools, students and employers from across East London (Barking & Dagenham, Havering, Redbridge, Waltham Forest), Essex, Thurrock and Southend-on-Sea.
If you can’t find what you are looking for, please call the office on 01708 436440. The office is open Monday to Friday, 8.30 to 16.00 in school term time and Monday to Thursday 8.30 to 14.00 in school holidays. Alternatively you can email the office at info@bepgroup.net.

pageCache.pageTitle: Info for parents – knife crime | BEP Group
pageCache.text:
Talking with young people or young adults about knives and weapons can be difficult, whether you are a parent, professional or a friend.
People may not want to talk about the subject as they might be worried that they will get into trouble, they are embarrassed, scared, or feel that carrying a knife makes them feel safer.
This page and downloadable resources (click here or on the image above) are to help you prepare for a conversation with someone about whether they are carrying a knife, why they are doing this and what you can do if they are.
